insider_take: This intimate Belgravia boutique hotel occupies a stunning Victorian townhouse where luxury meets British heritage in one of London's most prestigious postcodes.
whats_special: Hotel 41 sits directly opposite Buckingham Palace and is the sister property to The Rubens at the Palace. With just 30 rooms, it's one of London's most exclusive small luxury hotels, featuring dramatic black and white decor and personalized butler service. The hotel is part of Red Carnation Hotel Collection and holds a coveted position on the Royal Mews.
pro_tip: Book a Palace View room to watch the Changing of the Guard ceremony from your window - you'll have front-row seats to this iconic British tradition without the crowds below.
dont_miss: The hotel's Executive Lounge offers complimentary champagne and canapés throughout the day, plus the rooftop terrace provides stunning views over the Royal Mews. Take advantage of the 24-hour room service and explore nearby St. James's Park, just steps from your door.
pros: Iconic Buckingham Palace Views from the executive lounge and select rooms
Legendary butler service providing personalized, attentive care around the clock
Intimate boutique atmosphere with just 30 beautifully appointed rooms and suites
Prime Royal Westminster location steps from Buckingham Palace and St. James's Park
Complimentary all-day dining including afternoon tea and evening canapés in the executive lounge
cons: Compact room sizes typical of a historic London townhouse property
No on-site full-service restaurant; dining relies on the executive lounge and room service
